# Debating Communities and Networks Conference

> > An academic conference exploring digital networks, social media, and community engagement with focus on indigenous advocacy and online social change.

The Debating Communities and Networks Conference XII is hosted by Curtin University in Perth, Australia, on the lands of the Whadjuk Nyungar people. The conference examines how online communities, digital networks, and social media shape contemporary social change, identity formation, and indigenous advocacy.

## Conference Overview

- [Debating Communities and Networks Conference XII](https://networkconference.netstudies.org/2021/): The twelfth edition of the Debating Communities and Networks Conference hosted by Curtin University, exploring digital networks, social media, and community engagement with emphasis on indigenous advocacy and online social change
